put.summary:
Replace a credential after the provider has been asked about it (OP. SIGIL D-12). A key the
provider refuses (401 or 403) is `provider_key_rejected`, naming the provider, and nothing is
stored; a provider that cannot be asked leaves the key `not_verified`. The plaintext exists
only in this request, the check and encryption memory.

delete.summary: Remove a credential, returning to pooled service or required-policy refusal.

get.summary: List an organisation's endpoints, by name.

put.summary:
Register or replace an endpoint after checking it in its own format and auth: its address must
be allowed, and a key it refuses (401 or 403) is `provider_key_rejected` with nothing stored.
An endpoint that cannot be reached is saved `not_verified`. Moving a keyed endpoint to another
origin needs its key again. A scheme other than `none` needs a key (new or stored); `none`
with a key is refused, and `none` removes a stored one.

200.description: The endpoint and what its check listed

delete.summary: Remove an endpoint: its models stop being callable.

post.summary:
Check an endpoint again and record what it found. A key it refuses is recorded
`not_verified` and answered `provider_key_rejected`.

200.description: The endpoint and what its check listed
